timing: Registered after the first regular cold run selected a tree and foundation model but before any of the new three external training answer files were read.
question: Do genuinely matched training observations support unequal weights, and can retaining the several independently fitted replicas reduce prediction variability without more training?
weight_rule: Keep the ordinary agent's chosen members. For a pair estimate the first member's weight in increments of 1/8 from zero to one. For each held training fold choose a weight on all other matching folds by row-weighted declared metric, then score that choice on the held fold. Only use the median proposed weight if at least two held folds improve over the equal vote and the pooled out-of-fold gain is at least .003. Otherwise keep .5. Tie-break towards equal weighting. A single is kept verbatim.
replicas: As a separate prespecified inference diagnostic, combine 75% of the weighted full-refit probabilities with 25% of the similarly weighted arithmetic mean from all common inner-fold fits. No additional classifier training. Reconstruct the original ordinary prediction exactly as a pipeline check before sealing either alternative.
accounting: These are prediction-only alternatives on the same three matched training panels. Seal all six new prediction files before opening the panels. Report paired outcomes regardless of sign. Even a positive diagnostic does not by itself qualify as a new official release.
